# StakingRewardsManagerBase
[Git Source](https://github.com/OasisDEX/summer-earn-protocol/blob/main/packages/rewards-contracts/src/contracts/StakingRewardsManagerBase.sol)

**Inherits:**
[IStakingRewardsManagerBase](../interfaces/i-staking-rewards-manager-base.md), ReentrancyGuardTransient, ProtocolAccessManaged

**Titles:**
StakingRewardsManager, StakingRewards

Contract for managing staking rewards with multiple reward tokens in the Summer protocol

Contract for managing staking rewards with multiple reward tokens in the Summer protocol

Implements IStakingRewards interface and inherits from ReentrancyGuardTransient and ProtocolAccessManaged

Inspired by Synthetix's StakingRewards contract:
https://github.com/Synthetixio/synthetix/blob/v2.101.3/contracts/StakingRewards.sol

Implements IStakingRewards interface and inherits from ReentrancyGuardTransient and ProtocolAccessManaged
